statement: WiiBrew's Wii Motion Plus introduction documents an inactive MotionPlus at extension address 0xA60000 with six-byte ID 00 00 A6 20 00 05 at 0xA600FA, transitioning to the active 0xA40000 register mapping after a 0x04 write to 0xA600FE, with active ID suffix 04 05 and MotionPlus report data. These are community source facts consistent with pinned Linux host activation, not an authenticated hardware trace.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 120079 section introductory identification and activation; Linux hid-wiimote-core.c 469-555 consumer corroboration.
